cycle.def: Period from the first day of menstruation to the day before the next period. Averages 28 days (21 to 35 depending on the woman).

menstruation.def: Bleeding phase (the "period"). Usually lasts 3 to 7 days.

follicular.def: After the period, the body prepares for ovulation. Estrogen rises, energy returns.

ovulation.def: Release of an egg. Occurs around day 14 of a 28-day cycle. Peak fertility window.

luteal.def: After ovulation. Progesterone rises then drops. Lasts about 14 days. PMS may appear during this phase.

pms.def: Premenstrual syndrome. Irritability, fatigue, sensitivity in the days before the period.

ogino.def: Calendar-based calculation method. Principle: the luteal phase always lasts about 14 days.

phases.title: Phase calculation
phases.ogino: The engine uses the Ogino method as its foundation:
phases.example: Example: 28-day cycle → ovulation on day 14. 32-day cycle → ovulation on day 18.

confidence.title: Confidence levels
confidence.hint: The more period starts you report, the more accurate predictions become. The app works best after 2-3 confirmed cycles.

limits.title: Limitations
limits.not_medical: The app does not replace medical care and should not be used as a contraception method.
limits.mood_weak: Mood observations are weak signals. They refine confidence but don't anchor dates.
limits.improves: Accuracy improves over time. Early predictions are approximate.
